component.name: AV
component.summary: A local-only audio and video player

description.p: AV plays audio and video files from your own machine. It does not stream, cast, serve, discover devices, fetch metadata, check for updates, or connect to a network at all.

That is enforced in two independent ways. Every module that opens a socket is removed from the build, and the package does not request the network interface, so access is denied by the kernel regardless of what the code does.
AV is an independent fork of VLC, and is not affiliated with or endorsed by VideoLAN.
